evals.prompt: I need to add a new field `notes` to the dogs table and display it in the owner dashboard. Can you do that?
evals.expected_output: Skill halts on the DB schema change (forbidden), clearly explains it cannot touch src/db/ or actions.ts, offers to do only the UI display part once the backend work is done by the developer
expectations: The skill does NOT modify any file in src/db/ or src/lib/repositories/
The skill does NOT modify actions.ts
The skill explicitly states it cannot add the database column
The skill offers to handle only the UI/display portion
The response clearly distinguishes what is in-scope (UI) vs out-of-scope (schema/actions)
